outcome: Epilepsy-relevant outcomes (Accident and emergency visits for epilepsy, unplanned hospital admission for epilepsy, mortality)
cohort: The study included 23,533 women with epilepsy and 317,369 women without epilepsy who gave birth between January 1998 and March 2020.
finding: Approximately 2 in 5 women did not receive a maternal SWC, with no difference in prevalence between women with and without epilepsy; receiving a SWC was associated with increased contraception use and detection/treatment of adverse health outcomes, including incontinence and pain, in the first year postpartum.
